product_metadata.title: Ninja CW102BL Foodi NeverStick PossiblePan, Premium Set with 4-Quart Capacity Pan, Steamer/Strainer Basket, Glass Lid & Integrated Spatula, Nonstick, Durable & Oven Safe to 500°F, Macaron Blue
features: REPLACES 12 COOKING TOOLS: Your new 4-quart go-to pan replaces a stainless-steel fry pan, nonstick fry pan, sauté pan, skillet, saucier, saucepan, steamer, strainer, spatula, cast iron skillet, roasting pan, and baking dish.
STOVE TOP-TO-OVEN: Easily go from stove top to oven to table as it works on all cooktops and is oven safe up to 500°F so you can even bake like cast iron.

THOUGHTFUL DESIGN: Integrated utensil conveniently stores on the lid and is specially designed to match the curvature of the pan on one side to easily get into the edges of the pan, for perfect serving.
STEAMER & STRAINER: Integrated stainless-steel basket can steam veggies and dumplings or lift the ergonomic handle and use the convenient pour spouts to work as a strainer for pasta.
SEARS & HEATS EVENLY: Durable forged metal design quickly distributes and retains heat for excellent searing and perfect results every time.

10 YEAR GUARANTEE: NeverStick Technology is an exclusive nonstick coating that delivers easy food release day after day without sticking. Fully backed by the Ninja 10 Year Guarantee.* *When used as directed.
EASY CLEANUP: NeverStick interior enables you to quickly wipe away messes and is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning.
SAFE & EASY-TO-USE: Free of cadmium and lead. Compatible with gas, electric, glass ceramic, and induction stovetops.
WHAT’S INCLUDED: 4-Quart PossiblePan, Integrated Stainless Steel Steamer/Strainer Basket, 11-Inch Glass Lid, Integrated Detachable Spatula, & User/Recipe Guides.
description: Meet the Ninja Foodi NeverStick PossiblePan, the versatile 4-quart pan that makes anything possible. This go-to pan can replace 12 cooking tools like a nonstick fry pan, cast iron skillet, roasting pan, baking dish, steamer, strainer and more! Easily go from stove top to oven to table with trusted NeverStick performance that won’t stick, chip or flake. Experience fast and even heating with excellent searing on all cooktops and bake like cast iron since it’s oven safe up to 500°F. Use the convenient integrated spatula right at the table which is perfect for serving your friends and family. So many possibilities all in one pan.
